root_cause: payment-service container is started with a CMD override that always exits with code 1 and Docker restart=always keeps restarting it. Each restart attempt fails immediately (CRITICAL log emitted then exit 1), incrementing RestartCount and triggering Docker's exponential back-off (10s, 20s, 40s...)
expected_fix: Stop and remove the crash-looping container, then restart the healthy compose service: docker stop payment-service-crashloop && docker rm payment-service-crashloop && docker compose -f infra/docker-compose.yml up -d payment-service. In production: fix the startup configuration or code causing exit 1
